findings.note: The rookie caught 2 of 3 targets for 56 yards in Week 11, called his best game of the season, which suggests he has rarely reached 2 catches; he also missed Friday practice with an ankle issue but played and could see more big-play use against Detroit's 27th-ranked pass defense.
The Lions' opponent preview lists Thomas as Rome Odunze's backup at WR and Kalif Raymond's backup at KR/PR, so he is a reserve competing for targets with Odunze, Luther Burden and Colston Loveland.
Dave Richard's Week 12 PPR cheat sheet rates Thomas 3.35 on a 1-10 confidence scale, a low-end fantasy option; the game has a 55.5 total with the Bears as slight road favorites.
